question.prompt: A class has 50 students. Their ways of traveling to school are: 18 walk, 12 cycle, \(x\) take the bus, and 5 use other means. If a student is selected at random, what is the probability that the student takes the bus to school? (Express the result as a fraction in simplest form.)

solutions.explanation: First find \(x=50-18-12-5=15\), so the probability is \(15/50=3/10\).
solutions.title: Find the remaining count
